narrative_purpose: Shows what a second, independent origin would actually look like: two cells alike in every forced feature and opposite in the arbitrary one, because handedness is the fingerprint that shared ancestry cannot fake.
subject: Two simple cells presented side by side as matched specimen studies at identical scale, each a rounded translucent body with a thin bright membrane rim and a faintly granular interior. Inside each, a single long coiled strand of small linked beads spirals through the body — and the two spirals wind in opposite directions, one turning clockwise as it recedes, the other counterclockwise, mirror images of each other. Everything else about the two cells is deliberately identical: same size, same membrane, same interior texture, same number of coils.
scene: Two specimen studies floating against a plain dark ground with a soft vertical gap between them, no environment or setting.
camera: A flat straight-on view of both cells at matched scale and distance, as in a museum comparison plate.
light: Even faint cool light on both, each membrane carrying a delicate rim glow and each internal coil lit from within so its direction of winding is unmistakable.
palette: Void-indigo ground, the left cell's coil in cyan, the right cell's coil in magenta, both membranes in pale cool rim light, interiors dim and neutral.
style: Painterly naturalist specimen plate, hand-painted, the two studies rendered with identical technique so only the winding differs.
detail_level: Crisp on both coils and membranes so the opposite handedness is legible at a glance; interiors softly textured; the background entirely plain.
composition: Mirror symmetry about a central vertical axis, one cell either side, generous dark space above and below both for overlaid callouts.
consistency_notes: The coils must be single strands, not double helices, and their opposite winding must be the only difference between the two cells — every other feature identical, because the figure's whole point is that convergence covers everything except the arbitrary choice.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no chemical notation, no double helix, no nucleus or organelles, no photographic or 3D-render look, no microscope vignette, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
